verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say a feedback submission from its widget can start an intention, and an agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes tasks. Submissions route to a chosen project or to the organization's Feedback list, where spam can be dismissed. This directly covers turning feedback into an actionable intention and tasks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of how a PM reviews or edits the proposed tasks before acting on them.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention

citations.quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
Pick a project on that page and submissions route to that project.
Spam is dismissed here and goes no further.
